name: Soda
explanation: Soda is a once-in-a-while drink because it is very sweet and does not give the body many helpful nutrients.

name: Cookie
explanation: Cookies are a once-in-a-while food because they are sweet treats that usually have lots of added sugar.

name: Apple
explanation: Apples are an everyday food because they give your body fiber, water, and natural sweetness.

name: Salad
explanation: Salads are an everyday food because they give your body vitamins, minerals, and water.

name: Cheeseburger
explanation: Cheeseburgers are a sometimes food because they can have more calories, fat, and sodium than everyday foods.

name: Carrots
explanation: Carrots are an everyday food with crunch, color, and vitamin A to help your body grow strong.

name: Oatmeal
explanation: Oatmeal is an everyday food because it has whole grains that can help keep energy steady.

name: Grilled Chicken
explanation: Grilled chicken is an everyday food because it has protein that helps build and repair muscles.

name: Cheese Pizza
explanation: Cheese pizza can be a sometimes food because it has helpful ingredients, and it can also have more salt and fat.

name: Pancakes
explanation: Pancakes are a sometimes food, especially with syrup, because they can give quick energy but may not keep you full as long.

name: Granola Bar
explanation: Granola bars can be a sometimes food because some have oats and nuts, while others have lots of added sugar.

name: Fruit Juice
explanation: Fruit juice can be a sometimes drink because it has fruit flavor, but whole fruit usually has more fiber.

name: Cupcake
explanation: Cupcakes are a once-in-a-while food because they are sweet treats that usually have lots of added sugar.

name: Fries
explanation: Fries are a once-in-a-while food because they can have more oil and salt than everyday foods.

name: Candy
explanation: Candy is a once-in-a-while food because it is mostly sugar and is best enjoyed as a small treat.
